channel.title: Saurav Sana | Field Notes
channel.description: Field notes on distributed systems, queueing physics, and enterprise software economics. Grounded in reality, skeptical of architectural dogma.

item.title: Beyond the MPP Default: Designing Data Gateway for the 95% Reality
item.author: sana.saurav@gmail.com (Saurav Sana)
item.description: An architectural blueprint for turning immutable lakehouses into interactive, zero-copy operational engines for web APIs and AI agents—without paying the enterprise licensing penalty. Explores why traditional distributed MPP engines incur severe structural coordination overhead on small queries and introduces a stateless, application-aware gateway architecture.

item.title: The $28,500 PDF Nobody Read?
item.author: sana.saurav@gmail.com (Saurav Sana)
item.description: An empirical audit of corporate thought leadership, senior engineering opportunity costs, and why your marketing whitepaper got zero qualified leads. Evaluates the PR Decay Model of signal attenuation and the true cost of executive vanity content pipelines.

item.title: The Flaw of Sprints
item.author: sana.saurav@gmail.com (Saurav Sana)
item.description: Why Scrum Masters need Kingman’s formula and queueing math, not another colored sticky note or two-day certification. Examines how pushing team utilization to 100% guarantees non-linear wait time inflation and systematic sprint delivery failures.
